weapon_affix_roll.description: Determines whether a generated weapon receives a prefix, a suffix, both, or neither.
notes: bothChance is 0.0 for all tiers in this MVP. Future versions may set legendary to 0.5.
Roll uses weighted random from loot-affix-pools.json within the item's rarity tier.
Multiplayer: roll executes on host; result syncs to clients via item_instance_metadata.
This file is BML-owned dynamic data. Stock Barony cannot load it as standalone behavior.
Live gameplay is not verified; this data is self-test scaffolding only.
